monitor_the_situation.title: CENTCOM Redirects 44 Vessels, Disables 2 in Iran Blockade
Saudi-Backed Forces Strike Ansarallah Positions in Sanaa

— S3 · Conflict · Sanaa, Yemen · 45m ago. Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces announced strikes on Ansarallah (Houthi) positions along the line of contact in Sanaa, escalating the ongoing conflict.
Houthi Attack Wounds 11 Civilians in Southern Saudi Arabia

— S3 · Conflict · Southern Saudi Arabia · 1h ago. A Houthi attack on southern Saudi Arabia wounded 11 civilians, prompting the kingdom to warn of imminent coordinated attacks by Houthis and Iran-backed Iraqi militias.
— S3 · Conflict · Aden, Yemen · 2h ago. Yemeni Armed Forces (Ansarallah) launched drone strikes on Saudi-backed militant positions in Aden, with an explosion reported at a military camp.
